sn33.55:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Viññāṇe kho Vaccha apaccakkhakammā viññāṇasamudaye apaccakkhakammā viññāṇanirodhe apaccakkhakammā viññāṇanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya apaccakkhakammā || evam imāni anekavihitāni diṭṭhigatāni loke upajjanti Sassato loko ti vā Asassato loko ti vā || pe || || Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā ti || || Ayaṃ kho Vaccha hetu ayam paccayo yānimāni anekavihitāni diṭṭhigatāni loke uppajjanti || || Sassato loko ti vā Asassato loko ti vā || Antavā loko ti vā Anantavā loko ti vā || Taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīranti vā Aññaṃ jīvam aññaṃ sarīranti vā || Hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā Na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti || Hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato param maraṇāti vā Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā ti || || Vacchagotta-saṃyuttaṃ samattaṃ || || Ekapiṇḍakena pañcapaññāsasuttantā bhavanti || ||
sn33.55:2.0: Tassuddānam || || Aññāṇā Adassanaṃ ceva || Anabhisamayā Ananubodhā || Appativedhā Asallakkhaṇā || Anupalakkhaṇena || Apaccupalakkhaṇā || Asamapekkhaṇā Apaccupekkhaṇā || Apaccakkhakamman ti || || Sāvatthi || || Tatra
